aiSummary.oneLiner: An automated repository aggregating and testing high-quality, free proxy nodes updated every 30 minutes.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: FreeNodes is a highly automated service that collects, verifies, and shares free proxy configurations to help users bypass network restrictions. It leverages GitHub Actions to continuously scrape nodes and validates their speed and connectivity against GitHub servers every thirty minutes using the SubsCheck-Win-GUI tool. The project outputs these verified proxies in multiple formats—including YAML, Base64, and Mihomo—ensuring broad compatibility with popular proxy clients like Clash and V2Ray. It categorizes nodes by speed and region, providing a reliable, zero-cost pipeline for secure internet access.
keyFeatures: High-Frequency Updates: Automatically refreshes and tests the proxy node pool every 30 minutes to maintain reliability.
Automated Connectivity Testing: Verifies the speed and stability of every node using dedicated testing tools before publication.
Multi-Format Subscriptions: Provides node configurations in YAML, Base64, and Mihomo formats for seamless client integration.
Global Node Coverage: Aggregates proxies from various international regions, explicitly tagging their geographic locations.
Speed Categorization: Annotates individual nodes with their tested bandwidth capabilities to help users select optimal routes.

useCases.title: Bypassing Network Restrictions
useCases.description: Navigating strict geographic firewalls to access blocked international websites and services.

useCases.title: Client Configuration Testing
useCases.description: Testing network setups and proxy clients like Clash or V2Ray without paying for commercial VPN services.

useCases.title: Privacy-Focused Browsing
useCases.description: Masking origin IP addresses for lightweight web scraping, research, or anonymous internet browsing.

useCases.title: Backup Connectivity
useCases.description: Providing a reliable, secondary pool of proxy servers for use when primary commercial services experience downtime.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Users in heavily restricted network environments needing reliable, free proxy configurations. It requires familiarity with proxy clients such as Clash, V2Ray, or Shadowrocket.
